title: Zesty Rich Ukrainian Boudin Noir Skillet
description: A rich and creamy Ukrainian dish featuring boudin noir, perfect for a date night. This satvik friendly recipe is made with sashimi cut boudin noir and cooked to perfection on a tava griddle.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter on a tava griddle over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sashimi cut boudin noir and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Add the heavy cream, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter until it is fully incorporated.
Serve the boudin noir and sauce hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
